Prose.description: Long-form Markdown (GFM tables, block quotes, $$ math $$). Raw HTML is escaped. Use for articles, briefs and descriptions.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the text (as a third-level heading)

dropCap.description: Editorial drop cap on the first paragraph

id.description: Anchor id for in-page links (letters, digits, dashes)

WorkedExample.description: A worked example inside extra help: a title and the steps as Markdown (at most 1 800 characters). Static; it is one of the blocks generated for a learner who struggled with a part of the course, and every block cites its source fragments.

markdown.description: Markdown, at most 1 800 characters; raw HTML is escaped

id.description: Anchor id for in-page links (letters, digits, dashes)

PracticeQuestion.description: One multiple-choice practice question with exactly one right option. The learner picks an option and presses Check; the result is stated in words and the explanation appears only after that first attempt. Nothing is recorded or sent. Used in extra help; the plain-text fallback leaves out the answer.

markdown.description: Markdown, at most 1 800 characters; raw HTML is escaped

options.description: 2 to 5 answer options; exactly one is correct

explanation.description: Why the right option is right; shown only after the learner checks an answer

locale.description: Interface language of the fixed strings; filled by the app, authors and models leave it out

id.description: Anchor id for in-page links (letters, digits, dashes)

ElaborativeQuestion.description: An open question that asks the learner to explain an idea in their own words, with an optional notes field. What the learner types stays on their device; nothing is sent. Used in extra help.

markdown.description: Markdown, at most 1 800 characters; raw HTML is escaped
